description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git log graph visualization, specifically testing the output of 'git log --graph' with various complex merge scenarios (octopus merges). It contains test cases defined using functions like 'test_expect_success' to verify the graphical output of Git history with and without color formatting, covering different merge configurations and branch histories.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares the current Git log graph output against expected output without color.

methods.name: test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Compares the current Git log graph output against expected colored output.
